ns2:section.sectionText: Section 9--Topic: Investigating Contemporary Phenomena/Immersion Journalism. This course is open to sophomores, juniors and seniors. Please note the stated prerequisite. The registration system may temporarily allow you to select this course even if you do not meet the prerequisite, but it eventually will catch this problem and cancel your registration, by which time it may be difficult for you to find an alternative.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
